scope: Main-text structural units only, chapters85-90. No English wording, Ethiopic transcription, translation or language approval.
anchor_convention: Line1 is the first Ethiopic main-text line beneath the running header, not the header or apparatus. Lines count full physical main-text lines, including Roman chapter markers inline. A marker identifies an exact boundary; approximate x is only a locator in the viewed 842x1080 raster, not a claimed pixel-exact glyph bounding box. Unit1 begins at its Roman chapter boundary and is implicit. Ends are exclusive at the next baseline body marker or Roman chapter marker.
counting_method: Direct visual inspection of actual rendered scan pages, tracking baseline Arabic unit markers from Roman chapter boundary to next boundary. Superscript apparatus references and Greek parallel-page numbering excluded. No OCR or text extraction performed.
